The '''Drash-So labor camp''' was a prison established by [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]] on [[Drash-So]] during the [[Second Imperial Civil War]]. [[Ania Solo]] was imprisoned there during the war for murdering an individual. Her lover [[Ramid]] was also in the camp.

During their imprisonment, Solo was tormented by a [[Unidentified masked bounty hunter|prison guard]], but ultimately escaped with the help of [[AG-37]]. Ramid, however, was shot during the rescue and re-captured. At the end of the war, the camp [[Liberation of the Drash-So labor camp|was liberated]] by the [[Empire-in-exile]].
